rationale: Raised saturation from 0.85 to 1.0 and feedforward clamp to 1.0 so u-star~0.95 is reachable; enlarged integral authority I_LIM 0.25->0.65 and integral rates KI 0.01->0.02 / KI_FAR 0.002->0.008 with same anti-windup so the loop can supply +0.55 extra heat on the leaky plant; added slow online steady-state gain estimator K_hat (init 1.08, limits 0.35-1.30) from slow-filtered y_s/u_s that re-computes ff=(target-0.08)/K_hat. On nominal K_hat stays ~1.07 ff~0.39, on leaky plant it drifts to ~0.42 ff~0.95. KP 0.9->1.0, P_LIM 0.45->0.60 to keep warmup strong without breaking soft 0.85 limit.

CHANGED: tau ~70-85s, K~0.42-0.45 (y_ss(0.5)~0.30, y_ss(0.8)~0.42-0.44), a ~2.2x nominal, b ~unchanged, u-star(0.5)~0.93-1.0, delay still <10-15s, noise/quant unchanged (~0.005 steps). extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: warmup to 0.5 in ~150-180s, overshoot <0.56, settle u~0.38-0.40, in-band >0.79 after 300s, MAE ~0.011, no overrides. Leaky: warmup slower (~250-350s), u ramps 0.77->1.0 as K_hat 1.08->0.45 and integrator unwinds, y converges to 0.5 from below without 0.85/0.9 violation, in-band >0.90 after settling, steady u~0.92-0.98.
